slots.heading: Choose an operation
slots.caption: Sweep can exchange long shared-variable connections for local reads, or consolidate equivalent reads when one source is clearer.
slots.capture_instructions: Show the same Blueprint graph before and after Distribute: one Get Health wired to three distant calculations, then three local Gets near those consumers. Make node labels and wires readable.
slots.alt: Sweep can exchange long shared-variable connections for local reads, or consolidate equivalent reads when one source is clearer.

slots.heading: Responsibilities
slots.caption: Sweep separates native editor menu handling from graph transformation and data ownership.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram FSweepModule for context-menu registration and selection, SweepOperations for graph analysis/rewiring, and UE K2 Schema and UEdGraph as the native engine owners.
slots.alt: Sweep separates native editor menu handling from graph transformation and data ownership.

slots.heading: Install from a release
slots.caption: A correct project installation places Sweep.uplugin directly inside the Sweep plugin directory.
slots.capture_instructions: Show File Explorer at YourProject/Plugins/Sweep, with Sweep.uplugin, Source, Config, Resources and Doc visible; include the address bar proving no extra nested Sweep folder.
slots.alt: A correct project installation places Sweep.uplugin directly inside the Sweep plugin directory.

slots.heading: Try Sweep on a disposable Blueprint
slots.caption: A shared Variable Get can be distributed into local reads and restored with Undo.
slots.capture_instructions: Record Get Health connected to three separate consumer nodes, right-click its node body, choose Sweep > Distribute Variable Get, show the resulting local Gets, then Undo once to restore original wiring.
slots.alt: A shared Variable Get can be distributed into local reads and restored with Undo.

slots.heading: Choose based on the graph
slots.caption: Distribute favors local sources and Consolidate favors fewer repeated Get nodes.
slots.capture_instructions: Create two side-by-side Blueprint before/after pairs using the same variable: Distribute one shared Get into three local Gets; Consolidate three equivalent Gets into one chosen survivor.
slots.alt: Distribute favors local sources and Consolidate favors fewer repeated Get nodes.

slots.heading: Exact steps
slots.caption: Distribute creates local Variable Gets beside the nodes that consume a shared value.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture the same Blueprint graph before and after distributing one Get Health into three local Gets, showing the old long wires, all three destination nodes and the new shorter wires.
slots.alt: Distribute creates local Variable Gets beside the nodes that consume a shared value.

slots.heading: Eligibility and analysis
slots.caption: Sweep follows reroute chains to terminal inputs and groups those inputs by destination node.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw one Get output through two reroutes into three terminal input pins on only two destination nodes. Label 3 terminal inputs and 2 replacement Gets to explain grouping.
slots.alt: Sweep follows reroute chains to terminal inputs and groups those inputs by destination node.

slots.heading: Exact steps
slots.caption: The right-clicked Variable Get survives while equivalent selected Gets transfer their connections to it.
slots.capture_instructions: Show before/after Blueprint captures with three equivalent Get Health nodes selected; highlight the one right-clicked and retained, then show its combined outgoing wires.
slots.alt: The right-clicked Variable Get survives while equivalent selected Gets transfer their connections to it.

slots.heading: Failure rollback per source
slots.caption: Consolidation validates transferred connections and restores a rejected source when possible.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw an exact TryCreateConnection branch: success transfers outgoing wires and deletes redundant source; failure attempts to restore that source original links, not the entire batch.
slots.alt: Consolidation validates transferred connections and restores a rejected source when possible.

slots.heading: The right-click selection behavior
slots.caption: Sweep uses the graph selection captured before opening the context menu when the clicked Get was selected.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture three selected pure Variable Gets in Blueprint, right-click on one of those selected nodes, and show Sweep > Distribute Selected Variable Gets in the context menu.
slots.alt: Sweep uses the graph selection captured before opening the context menu when the clicked Get was selected.

slots.heading: Selection snapshots
slots.caption: Sweep uses the stored selected Gets only when the right-clicked Get belonged to that selection.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram focused Blueprint graph -> selection snapshot -> decision clicked Get in snapshot? Yes uses supported selected Gets; No falls back to clicked Get only.
slots.alt: Sweep uses the stored selected Gets only when the right-clicked Get belonged to that selection.

slots.heading: The visual tradeoff
slots.caption: Local variable reads reduce wire travel, while one shared source reduces repeated Get nodes.
slots.capture_instructions: Create one Blueprint example shown in two layouts with identical variable context: several local Gets beside consumers versus a single central Get with longer wires; label both tradeoffs.
slots.alt: Local variable reads reduce wire travel, while one shared source reduces repeated Get nodes.

slots.heading: Three safety rules
slots.caption: Sweep validates variable identity, handles reroutes deliberately and uses Unreal K2 schema connections.
slots.capture_instructions: Create three labeled technical illustrations: identical VariableReference and context, reroute chains that remain or become unused, and K2 schema validating a new wire.
slots.alt: Sweep validates variable identity, handles reroutes deliberately and uses Unreal K2 schema connections.

slots.heading: During Distribute
slots.caption: Distribution follows reroutes to the consumers and removes only reroutes with no remaining live output.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a Get feeding two consumer calculations through a two-deep branched reroute chain. Distribute it, showing new Gets near both consumers and an unrelated still-live reroute remaining.
slots.alt: Distribution follows reroutes to the consumers and removes only reroutes with no remaining live output.

slots.heading: Reachability cleanup
slots.caption: Orphaned reroutes are removed iteratively from downstream nodes back toward the old source.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw a before/after two-reroute chain; show downstream losing its outputs, then upstream becoming orphaned and both being removed, while a still-live branch remains.
slots.alt: Orphaned reroutes are removed iteratively from downstream nodes back toward the old source.

slots.heading: Example: same variable, different target
slots.caption: Variable Gets with the same visible name are not equivalent when their target-object context differs.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture two Blueprint Get Health nodes with clearly labeled Target A and Target B object wires, plus an eligible pair reading from the same target; mark the two different-target Gets Not equivalent.
slots.alt: Variable Gets with the same visible name are not equivalent when their target-object context differs.

slots.heading: Comparison implementation
slots.caption: Sweep checks the underlying variable reference and every relevant input-context field before consolidating.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram the exact decision checks: same graph, pure Get, same VariableReference, SelfContextInfo, matching input names/count, defaults and same linked context pins. Show rejection on any mismatch.
slots.alt: Sweep checks the underlying variable reference and every relevant input-context field before consolidating.

slots.heading: Handling nearby nodes
slots.caption: Sweep positions local Gets near consuming inputs while leaving existing graph nodes in place.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a moderately crowded Blueprint graph inside a comment box; run Distribute and show a new local Get move to an available vertical position left of its destination without shifting existing nodes.
slots.alt: Sweep positions local Gets near consuming inputs while leaving existing graph nodes in place.

slots.heading: Search strategy
slots.caption: Sweep tries nearby vertical positions and snaps the chosen Get to the Blueprint graph grid.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a graph-coordinate diagram with the initial point 220 units left of the destination, vertical candidate steps of 56 up/down, 18 clearance against nearby nodes and 16-unit grid snap.
slots.alt: Sweep tries nearby vertical positions and snaps the chosen Get to the Blueprint graph grid.

slots.heading: Best verification sequence
slots.caption: A complete Sweep refactor can be undone and redone as one Unreal Editor transaction.
slots.capture_instructions: Record a shared Get distributing into local Gets, press Undo to restore the exact original nodes and wires, then Redo to reapply the refactor. Keep the camera fixed.
slots.alt: A complete Sweep refactor can be undone and redone as one Unreal Editor transaction.

slots.heading: Transaction boundaries
slots.caption: Sweep groups Blueprint, graph, node and schema connection changes inside one editor transaction.
slots.capture_instructions: Draw FScopedTransaction enclosing Blueprint Modify, Graph Modify, affected Get/consumer nodes, K2 schema TryCreateConnection, then MarkBlueprintAsModified and NotifyGraphChanged.
slots.alt: Sweep groups Blueprint, graph, node and schema connection changes inside one editor transaction.

slots.heading: Two C++ responsibilities
slots.caption: Sweep separates user-facing menu integration from the code that edits Blueprint graphs.
slots.capture_instructions: Diagram FSweepModule (context menus and selection snapshots) beside SweepOperations (analysis, equivalence, placement, rewiring), both connected to Unreal Blueprint graph and K2 schema.
slots.alt: Sweep separates user-facing menu integration from the code that edits Blueprint graphs.

slots.heading: Menu behavior
slots.caption: Sweep commands appear inside the native Blueprint Variable Get context menu when eligible.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a real Blueprint Editor graph with a pure Variable Get node right-clicked; show the Sweep menu section with Distribute or Consolidate command visible and nearby connected nodes.
slots.alt: Sweep commands appear inside the native Blueprint Variable Get context menu when eligible.

slots.heading: Registration and teardown
slots.caption: Sweep registers a GraphEditor menu extension and a selection snapshot ticker during its editor-module lifetime.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a lifecycle diagram: StartupModule registers FGraphEditorModule extender and FTSTicker; context-menu callback checks eligibility; ShutdownModule removes extender/ticker and clears weak snapshots.
slots.alt: Sweep registers a GraphEditor menu extension and a selection snapshot ticker during its editor-module lifetime.

slots.heading: Distribute at a glance
slots.caption: Distribution creates local sources while consolidation merges equivalent sources, retaining valid connections.
slots.capture_instructions: Create two short flowcharts: Analyze -> Group terminals -> Spawn local Gets -> Reconnect/Clean; and Verify equivalence -> Choose clicked anchor -> Transfer wires -> Delete redundant Gets.
slots.alt: Distribution creates local sources while consolidation merges equivalent sources, retaining valid connections.

slots.heading: Source organization
slots.caption: Sweep changes ordinary UEdGraph nodes and pin links rather than creating custom asset or runtime data.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a source ownership diagram showing SweepModule.cpp menu and snapshots, SweepOperations.cpp graph edit/transactions, and UEdGraph/UK2Node_VariableGet stored in Blueprint package; Editor-only module.
slots.alt: Sweep changes ordinary UEdGraph nodes and pin links rather than creating custom asset or runtime data.

slots.heading: Start with these checks
slots.caption: Sweep issues can usually be narrowed to menu availability, eligibility, selection or graph reconnection.
slots.capture_instructions: Create a simple troubleshooting flowchart with plugin enabled, K2 pure Get node body, valid terminal count or equivalent selection, then connection and layout outcomes; link branches to the manual.
slots.alt: Sweep issues can usually be narrowed to menu availability, eligibility, selection or graph reconnection.

slots.heading: Why can't I merge two Gets named Health?
slots.caption: Two Gets with identical visible names can read different target objects and must remain separate.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture Target A -> Get Health and Target B -> Get Health in one Blueprint graph; make object target wires clearly visible and show they are not consolidation-equivalent.
slots.alt: Two Gets with identical visible names can read different target objects and must remain separate.

slots.heading: Sweep is missing from the menu
slots.caption: The Sweep menu appears for eligible pure Variable Get node bodies rather than pin clicks or arbitrary nodes.
slots.capture_instructions: Capture a side-by-side Blueprint example: context menu from eligible Get node body showing Sweep, and context menu from its output pin not showing Sweep.
slots.alt: The Sweep menu appears for eligible pure Variable Get node bodies rather than pin clicks or arbitrary nodes.

slots.caption: Sweep diagnostics proceed from module and menu conditions through selection, eligibility and graph modifications.
